originalTitle: One dead, homes swept away after Hurricane Lala lashes Hawaii
summary: A search-and-rescue operation is under way after properties were uprooted from their foundations.
content:
Hawaii is facing flash floods and mudslides that have swept away some homes after category one Hurricane Lala skirted Big Island, leaving one person dead in a car accident.

A search-and-rescue operation was under way after several properties were uprooted from their foundations in the coastal communities of Naalehu and Waiohinu.

Despite not even making landfall, the storm still dumped up to 35in (89cm) of rain in places, sending torrents raging down mountainsides. More than 200,000 householders were without power.

Although Lala has weakened to a tropical storm and was moving westward, south of Hawaii, the danger is not over, say officials.

The storm's eyewall howled within 30 miles (48km) of Big Island's South Point overnight, but it was close enough to bring flash flooding, Hawaii County said on Sunday.

After gaining hurricane strength on Saturday afternoon, packing wind speeds of 91mph, Lala's winds have now decreased to near 65mph, said the National Hurricane Center (NHC) in its latest advisory at 14:00 EDT (18:00 GMT) on Sunday.

"It's actually hard for us to see... I've got a lot of water in my eyes," says a local reporter during a live TV broadcast on the Hawaii County coast

But tropical storm warnings remain in effect for all eight of Hawaii's major islands.

"Lala is expected to produce additional rainfall of 4 to 8 inches across the Big Island and windward Maui, with maximum storm totals of 30 to 35 inches," the NHC said, while the rest of the island chain can expect rainfall of 4 to 6in.

The US National Weather Service's office in Honolulu said it had had reports of two homes being swept away amid the intense rainfall.

Mayor Kimo Alameda said the county's civil defence agency had launched a search-and-rescue operation to find people whose homes may have been destroyed in the floods.

"What makes this very challenging is that there's rushing water, there's debris, there's boulders on the road, and it's dark," he said earlier.

Watch: Strong winds and downpours in Maui and Honolulu as storm Lala approaches

About 180 Hawaii National Guard members have been deployed to help with the emergency response.

Some 219,000 customers had lost electricity on Hawaii as of Sunday morning local time, according to tracker PowerOutage.

Three hospitals also lost power, but had backup generators.

Big Island's two main airports, Hilo International and Ellison Onizuka Kona, were temporarily closed, but have since reopened.

According to the governor, 190 flights have been postponed.

In Maui, some residents were left without water supply on Saturday.

Iniki, a powerful category four storm, was the last hurricane to hit Hawaii back in 1992.

It caused six deaths and $3bn in damage after making landfall on the southern coast of Kauai.

Hurricane season in the US has been relatively quiet the last few years - the last major storm was category three Hurricane Milton, which hit Florida in October 2024.

This year has seen a strong El Niño - a periodically occurring area of unusually warm surface water - develop in the Pacific, driven in part by climate change.

As hurricanes and typhoons feed off warm sea waters, this spike in ocean temperatures could facilitate a higher number of storms that grow to have a greater intensity.

chineseTitle: 飓风“拉拉”袭击夏威夷，造成一人死亡，房屋被冲走
chineseSummary: 房屋被连根拔起后，搜救行动正在进行中。
chineseContent:
一级飓风“拉拉”绕过大岛后，夏威夷正面临山洪和泥石流，一些房屋被冲走，造成一人在车祸中死亡。

纳阿莱胡和怀奥希努沿海社区的几处房屋被连根拔起，搜救行动正在进行中。

尽管风暴尚未登陆，但部分地区的降雨量仍高达 35 英寸（89 厘米），激流从山坡上肆虐而下。超过20万住户断电。

官员们表示，虽然拉拉已经减弱为热带风暴，并向西移动到夏威夷南部，但危险尚未结束。

夏威夷县周日表示，风暴眼墙一夜之间在距大岛南角 30 英里（48 公里）范围内呼啸而过，但距离足够近，足以引发山洪暴发。

美国国家飓风中心 (NHC) 在周日美国东部时间 14:00（格林威治标准时间 18:00）发布的最新报告中表示，周六下午飓风强度增强，风速达到 91 英里/小时，现在拉拉的风速已降至接近 65 英里/小时。

“我们实际上很难看到......我的眼睛里进了很多水，”一名当地记者在夏威夷县海岸的电视直播中说道

但热带风暴警报对夏威夷所有八个主要岛屿仍然有效。

NHC 表示：“预计拉拉将给大岛和毛伊岛迎风区带来 4 至 8 英寸的额外降雨量，最大风暴总量为 30 至 35 英寸，而岛链的其他地区预计降雨量为 4 至 6 英寸。”

美国国家气象局位于檀香山的办公室表示，接到报告称，两栋房屋在强降雨中被冲走。

市长基莫·阿拉米达表示，该县民防机构已启动搜救行动，寻找房屋可能在洪水中被毁的人们。

“这非常具有挑战性，因为这里有湍急的水流、碎片、路上有巨石，而且天很黑，”他早些时候说。

观看：随着风暴“拉拉”临近，毛伊岛和檀香山出现强风和倾盆大雨

大约 180 名夏威夷国民警卫队成员已被部署协助应对紧急情况。

据 PowerOutage 追踪公司统计，截至当地时间周日上午，夏威夷约有 219,000 名客户断电。

三家医院也断电，但有备用发电机。

大岛的两个主要机场希洛国际机场和埃里森奥尼祖卡科纳机场暂时关闭，但后来重新开放。

据州长称，已有 190 个航班被推迟。

在毛伊岛，一些居民周六没有供水。

伊尼基 (Iniki) 是一场强大的四级风暴，是 1992 年袭击夏威夷的最后一场飓风。

它在可爱岛南部海岸登陆后造成 6 人死亡和 30 亿美元的损失。

过去几年，美国的飓风季节相对平静 - 上一次重大风暴是 2024 年 10 月袭击佛罗里达州的三级飓风米尔顿。

今年，太平洋地区出现了强烈的厄尔尼诺现象——一种周期性发生的异常温暖的地表水区域，部分原因是气候变化。

由于飓风和台风以温暖的海水为食，海洋温度的飙升可能会导致更多风暴的出现，而且风暴的强度也会变得更大。
